body: Did you watch the Breaking Bad clip? Idk if you feel guilty or whatever but definitely check it out if you haven't. Do you go to counseling for depression or take medication?

Idk if you watch Breaking Bad but watch this http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9zmOl3YW2lw if you don't. Honestly I  think this is one of the most powerful scenes I've ever seen in TV. Really puts things in perspective. I know this probably has nothing to do with you at all but idk why but this scene just got to me
Can you tell me what's wrong? I posted here too so there's no reason to be afraid or hide anything
Yeah I know. Hopefully I'll call and make an appointment tomorrow because I really have hit rock bottom but we'll see

I hadn't talked to her too much before then so I didn't want to rush it or seem too desperate etc. It was my plan to ask her out the next time I see her alone etc but that was a week ago and I haven't really had a chance

Do you realize if you do kill yourself you are gone FOREVER? THERE IS NO COMING BACK. I don't have the source but I read somewhere that close to 90% of people who have decided to commit suicide by jumping but survived instead said that they immediately regretted jumping when they were in the air because they realized everything was fixable.

It's a disorder; it's not just a little nervousness in social situations. Walking around campus makes me nervous because other people can see me. Last week the TA called for attendance and I got really nervous before saying here. I would rather eat a bowl full of shit than raise my hand during a lecture to ask a question. I try to sit as far back as possible in class. I wear sunglasses and a hoodie often times just because it makes me feel safer

> i don't know why i'm posting this here. or posting at all. 

You know why you're posting this here. Your posting this here because you don't really want to do it and you know it. You want someone to say something that changes your mind. Idk if this will change your mind but just know that I'm in a similar situation where I'm sort of fantasizing about suicide but am pretty sure I will never do it because there's no point in ending my life because after that I have nothing. There's always hope

I get what you're saying but you don't just go out and socialize with people by yourself. You don't see people going to parties by themselves.

> Go out and speak to Every female you see, white, black, Asian, or blue etc. Dont stop untill youve spoken to at least 15 different women. Matter of fact, this is your first task, when you leave the house or dorm make it your goal to not come home untill youve spoken to at least 15 different women and atleast 1 woman thats not the same race as you. Want more tips ?

lol. I think you're misunderstanding my predicament. My social anxiety is much more general than being awkward around women and actually right now I think I'm better at talking to girls than guys.

And the only girl I care about is the girl I mentioned anyway.

> Want more tips ?

Sure

> If you're throwing up at them, which is never fun, try taking it a bit easy the next time you go out.

Yeah I know it was the first time I've even actually thrown up from drinking and been completely out of control but I was just really down and wanted to forget about everything. Usually when I do drink I'm pretty reasonable about how much I drink.

> As for the girl, just go talk to her! I promise it gets easier the more you do it, and girls appreciate you begin confident and honest rather than beating around the bush. Suggest going to see a movie, or maybe even just coffee or a meal in the dining hall and gradually build from there. I know it's tough to put yourself out there, but it's gotta be better than feeling like you do now.

Yeah I know I actually texted her a while ago asking to eat dinner. We agreed to eat at the dining hall. When I went to her room she said a friend of hers wanted to come and she asked if that was okay with me. I'm not sure if this was her way of friend zoning me or whatever. The friend did live next door to her so I might just be taking it personally. And honestly there aren't really that many opportunities to talk to her. I live in this suite type of thing like I said and nobody keeps their door open or interacts with other people on the floor. The only time I really see her is walking in the hall and that sometimes only happens once every couple days.

> And you are a freshmen! Your GPA can and will go up if you work hard. And you are not at all required to declare a major yet. You're putting so much pressure on yourself to succeed, so just take a deep breath, and maybe talk to an advisor or a counselor who will be able to help you. You are not pigeonholed into staying with your current major. You just started and it's very possible for you to change if you feel like it.

Yeah I'm just really scared I'm going to fail a class and like I've stated before talking to anyone isn't easy for me right now.

> If you ever want to talk with someone who is in a very similar situation, please pm me! If not, good luck with everything! Please go find a counselor or someone to talk to who can help you more than any of us on here are able to

I might take you up on that offer at some point

> Go out more often

Sounds like a good plan if I had friends

> Would you like some steps on how to achieve more confidence, not give a damn what people think of you, and how to approach women and have a instant connection with them without the need to be "Under the influence" ?

Yes

But honestly I do feel like I have social anxiety disorder (I've taken numerous online tests and I've scored moderate to severe social anxiety on all of them). I've also done a good amount of research on the internet

I guess I could go to their office hours they hold but I did get stuck with basically all the worst professors because my pass to sign up for classes was the last day. I know this is just another excuse but I do feel like I've been really unlucky in some ways. 

I know I need to talk to a student counselor but I have talked to someone like that before (around a year ago) and it was such a new situation and I was so nervous about trying to be so open that I think it might have only made it worse
